podcast.title: Shared Stages with Pezz
podcast.body: Flashlight Brown, described as a "punk rock on a scob band," played shows with Pezz in the early Toronto music scene, showcasing the genre fluidity of the time. "back in the day, like we would play with, you know, flashlight brown and there were like a punk rock on a scob band."
